description: Returns a normalized availability handoff for a source-linked Orange County, CA barbershop, including availability class live, booking-site, or none; it does not guarantee a slot. Use when: the user has selected a barbershop and wants its provider handoff to check a service and, optionally, an appointment date. Do not use when: the user needs a guaranteed live appointment slot or price, beauty services beyond barbershops, results outside Orange County, payment, or a completed booking; availability only returns a class and provider handoff.

appointment_date.description: Optional desired appointment date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

business_id.description: Required stable business ID returned by search.

service.description: Optional published service requested, such as haircut or beard trim.

name: availability
title: Get Barbershop Availability Handoff
